R104_LABEL_CERTIFICATION.description: Certify the specified deterministic simultaneous-labeling recursion, conditional only on the stated finite-box interface.

C9000104.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 104 (Quasipolynomial algorithms for mean-payoff, stochastic and parity games.; papers: Turn-Based Stochastic Mean-Payoff Games in Deterministic Quasipolynomial Time; Mean-payoff parity games in quasipolynomial time; Deterministic quasipolynomial-time mean-payoff games; Randomized quasipolynomial-time mean-payoff games; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/104.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C104_DETERMINISTIC.statement: A uniform deterministic algorithm computes the zero-threshold winning set of a finite binary-weighted mean-payoff game in 2^{O(log^2(L+2))} bit operations.

C104_RANDOMIZED.statement: A uniform randomized algorithm returns the complete mean-payoff winning set with probability at least 7/8 and every tape uses 2^{O(log^2(L+2))} bit operations.

C104_STOCHASTIC.statement: A uniform deterministic algorithm computes the nonnegative expected mean-payoff value set for rational turn-based stochastic games in 2^{O(log^2(L+2))} bit operations.

C104_PARITY.statement: A uniform deterministic algorithm computes the vertices winning for parity and nonnegative mean payoff in 2^{O(log^2(L+2))} bit operations.

C104_LABEL_CORE.statement: For every admissible finite nonempty dimension, integer lower endpoint, dyadic width and positive rational masses, the specified two-pass recursion terminates and simultaneously satisfies every Max and Min witness claim.

C104_BOX_INTERFACE.statement: The staged companion's support-restricted comparison and finite synchronous Basic iteration hold on arbitrary finite integer boxes for the perturbed game operator.

C104_BASE.statement: The mass and small-width base cases satisfy all simultaneous witness obligations, using the finite-box interface only in the latter.

C104_TRANSLATION.statement: Integer scalar translation and clipping preserve the required comparison inequality, have exact support at gaps < r contained in the original support, and claim all gaps <= r/32.

C104_DOWN.statement: Assuming correctness of smaller-rank children, the downward pass preserves Max peaks, makes negative overrides safe, and forces absolute Min gap-support mass > 3/4 at its stopped pivot.

C104_UP.statement: Assuming correctness of smaller-rank children, the upward pass preserves Min peaks, makes positive overrides safe, preserves the first heavy support, and forces absolute Max gap-support mass > 3/4.

C104_REWEIGHT.statement: The provisional half-width call labels every heavy gap support favorably, so each unsettled original witness has reweighted support mass strictly below one.

C104_RANK.statement: Both finite pivot passes and every recursive child terminate by rank d+B(min_i a_i*b_i); only the provisional child preserves B.

C104_GAME_REDUCTION.statement: The initial wide-box solution has two separated bands whose positional strategies give the exact winning partition.

C104_BIT_BOUND.statement: The recursion's one budget-preserving child and O(n) budget-decreasing children give a quasipolynomial call count with polynomial local bit cost.

C104_RANDOMIZED_RECOVERY.statement: The randomized manuscript's potential-recovery and probability/bit analyses are correct; not audited in this mission.

C104_DISCOUNTED_EXTENSION.statement: Discounted translations, flooring and labeling recursion are valid; not certified by the deterministic core alone.

C104_STOCHASTIC_REDUCTION.statement: The stochastic value-separation and discounted-to-mean-payoff reduction and complexity bounds hold; not audited here.

C104_PARITY_REDUCTION.statement: The parity reduction and its complexity bound hold given the deterministic mean-payoff interface; not audited here.
